parts.text:
You are a job-matching assistant.
Below is a job alert email and my CV.

Extract every job listed in the email.
For each job return:
title, company, location, link,
score (0-100 match to my CV),
reason (one short sentence in Hebrew).

If the email has no jobs, return [].
Return ONLY a valid JSON array, no extra text.

For link: copy the full URL if it exists, otherwise write the job number.

MY CV:

[YOUR CV HERE]

Scoring rules:
- High score: student or junior roles in operations, logistics, data or industrial engineering.
- Low score: roles requiring 3+ years of experience, senior/manager titles, or unrelated fields (sales, customer service, security guard).
